rec.name: Countdown Timer Section (Global)
rec.status: Built — launched (section coded by Rana, documented in Slite; a few acceptance-criteria items are not visible in the delivered code)

what.text: A configurable countdown timer section (ed-countdown-timer.liquid) that counts down to a set end date and shows days, hours, minutes and seconds. It has an optional sub-headline, a headline and an outline CTA button. Two layouts are available: Minimalist (horizontal: text on the left, timer on the right) and Vertical (centered, with a large timer under the text). The background can be a color, an image or a video, with an optional color overlay. The original brief also asked for use in the announcement bar, the BuyBox, the Cart Drawer and under the hero image or price, so it would work as both a section and a block.

why.text: A visible deadline creates urgency and loss aversion. Shoppers who see time running out for a promotion (for example 'Last chance – 20% off sale items') are more likely to decide now instead of postponing the purchase. A live ticking timer makes the deadline concrete. A matching CTA next to it gives a direct next step. Because the timer can be switched off, the same element also works as a plain text-based scarcity message.

how.text: 1) Create the section file ed-countdown-timer.liquid in the theme and paste the provided code. 2) Add the section to the desired template through the theme editor. 3) Choose the layout style (Minimalist = horizontal, Vertical). 4) Add a 'Countdown header' block with sub-headline, headline (rich text), button text and URL, and optionally 'open in new tab'. 5) Add a 'Countdown timer' block with the end date and the labels for days, hours, minutes and seconds. 6) Set the background color, text color, overlay color and opacity, and optionally a background image or video. 7) Optionally enable 'customize settings' to override font sizes, weights, gaps and button height separately for desktop and mobile. JavaScript in the section runs the live countdown and loads resources. Documentation exists in Slite and a support video was recorded.

items: Background: color, image or video (video/image cover classes are in the code)
Background color, text color, overlay color and overlay opacity
Section padding top/bottom, separate for desktop and mobile
Header block: sub-headline, headline (rich text), text transform for both
Header block: font size and weight for headline/sub-headline, separate for desktop and mobile (via 'customize settings')
CTA button: text, URL, open in new tab, button height (outline style, colors follow the text color)
Timer block: end date, labels for days/hours/minutes/seconds
Timer block: digit size/weight, unit size/weight, gap and top spacing for desktop and mobile

Requested in the brief but not visible in the code excerpt: toggle to hide seconds, toggle to disable the countdown (text only), freely chosen text alignment, separate desktop/mobile banner images, free CTA background color

dependencies.text: No metafield needed (ticket field says MF/N). The countdown date comes from a section block setting. The code uses theme CSS variables and classes (.container, .button, .heading, settings.heading_color), so it assumes a Broadcast-like theme structure. The reference designs came from the Broadcast and Taiga themes. The code file is cut off mid-script, so the JavaScript logic could not be verified. The date is hardcoded to an 11:59 -12:00 timezone offset. The digits in the markup are static placeholders (14/15/34/51) until the JS updates them. The brief's additional placements (announcement bar, BuyBox block, Cart Drawer block) are not confirmed as delivered.

items: Conversion rate during the promotion period
Click-through rate on the countdown CTA
Bounce rate / scroll depth at the placement
Promotion-day share of revenue vs. a control without a timer

images.caption: Minimalist/horizontal layout on a photo background: sub-headline 'Last chance', headline 'Get 20% off all sale items', outline button 'Shop 20% off now' on the left, and the timer (days, hours, minutes, seconds) on the right.
Vertical/centered layout on a solid yellow background: bold two-line headline with a large gradient-colored timer below and small uppercase unit labels.
Compact card style on a dark background with a glowing headline, sub-line 'Sale endet in:' and a timer with divider lines between the units (days/hours/min/sec in German). Used as a design reference.
Theme editor setting 'Layout style' with the options Minimalist (horizontal) and Vertical.
